hospital_course: Patient was admitted for observation following a first-time febrile seizure. He was managed with Paracetamol and tepid sponging for fever control. IV Amoxicillin-Clavulanate was initiated for right acute otitis media. Seizure prophylaxis was not started as it was a first, short-duration febrile seizure with normal EEG and CT head scans. Fever resolved by day 2 of admission. The patient was stepped down to oral antibiotics on day 2 and was tolerating oral intake well. Blood culture showed no growth at 48 hours.
allergies: No Known Drug Allergies (NKDA) - Verify with patient
follow_up: Follow up with Paediatrics OPD in 1 week. Schedule ENT review in 2 weeks for otitis media resolution. Repeat EEG if further seizures occur. Parents have been counselled on febrile seizure management at home. Clinician signature required before discharge.
